```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(car)
```

```{r}
data <- read_csv("../data/TRAR11_F2_PTU.csv")

data <- data %>%
  clean_names()

str(data)
```

```{r}
hr_data <- data %>%
  select(
    concentration_g_l,
    heart_rate_bpm) %>%
  filter(!is.na(heart_rate_bpm)) %>%
  mutate(concentration_g_l = factor(concentration_g_l, levels = c("DMSO", "0.02", "0.04", "0.06", "0.08", "0.1")))

str(hr_data)
```

heart rate linear model
```{r}
heart_model<-lm(heart_rate_bpm ~ concentration_ug_l, data = hr_data)
summary(heart_model)
``

hr_anova<-aov(heart_rate_bpm ~ concentration_ug_l, data = hr_data)
summary(hr_anova)
```

```{r}
heart_plot <- ggplot(hr_data, aes(x = concentration_g_l, y = heart_rate_bpm)) +

  # Mean ± SE
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Raw data
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = concentration_g_l),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
    "DMSO" = "#A1D99B",
    "0.02" = "#74C476",
    "0.04" = "#41AB5D",
    "0.06" = "#238B45",
    "0.08" = "#006D2C",
    "0.1"  = "#00441B"
      
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = expression("PTU Concentration (g/L)"),
    y = "Heart rate (bpm)"
  ) +

  theme_bw()

heart_plot
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/heart_rate.png",
  plot = heart_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
hatch_data <- data %>%
  select(
    concentration_g_l,
    hatch_dpf,
    day_dosed_dpf) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hatch_dpf),
         day_dosed_dpf %in% c(0, 2)) %>%
  mutate(
    concentration_g_l = factor(concentration_g_l, levels = c("DMSO", "0.02", "0.04", "0.06", "0.08", "0.1")),
    day_dosed_dpf = factor(day_dosed_dpf, levels = c(0, 2))
  )

str(hatch_data)
```

hatch model
```{r}
hatch_model <- lm(
  percent_hatched ~ concentration_ug_l * dpf + plate_number,
  data = hatch_long
)

summary(hatch_model)
anova(hatch_model)
```

pair-wise post hoc
```{r}
emm_hatch <- emmeans(hatch_model, ~ concentration_ug_l | dpf)

pairs(emm_hatch, adjust = "tukey")
```

```{r}
hatch_plot <- ggplot(hatch_data, aes(x = concentration_g_l, y = hatch_dpf)) +

  # Raw data (drawn first, so it sits at the back)
  geom_jitter(aes(color = concentration_g_l), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # Mean ± SE (drawn last, so it sits on top)
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black") +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "DMSO" = "#A1D99B",
      "0.02" = "#74C476",
      "0.04" = "#41AB5D",
      "0.06" = "#238B45",
      "0.08" = "#006D2C",
      "0.1"  = "#00441B"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ day_dosed_dpf, labeller = labeller(day_dosed_dpf = function(x) paste("Dosed at", x, "dpf"))) +

  labs(
    x = "PTU Concentration (g/L)",
    y = "Day Hatched (dpf)"
  ) +

  theme_bw()

hatch_plot
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/hatch.png",
  plot = hatch_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
gfp_data <- data %>%
  select(
    concentration_g_l,
    ctcf,
    day_dosed_dpf) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctcf)) %>%
  mutate(
    concentration_g_l = factor(concentration_g_l, levels = c("DMSO", "0.02", "0.04", "0.06", "0.08", "0.1")),
    day_dosed_dpf = factor(day_dosed_dpf),
    log_ctcf = log(ctcf+1)
  )

str(gfp_data)
```

```{r}
gfp_plot <- ggplot(gfp_data, aes(x = concentration_g_l, y = log_ctcf)) +

  # Raw data (drawn first, so it sits at the back)
  geom_jitter(aes(color = concentration_g_l), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # Mean ± SE (drawn last, so it sits on top)
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black") +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "DMSO" = "#A1D99B",
      "0.02" = "#74C476",
      "0.04" = "#41AB5D",
      "0.06" = "#238B45",
      "0.08" = "#006D2C",
      "0.1"  = "#00441B"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ day_dosed_dpf, labeller = labeller(day_dosed_dpf = function(x) paste("Dosed at", x, "dpf"))) +

  labs(
    title = "Thyroid Follicles",
    x = "PTU Concentration (g/L)",
    y = "log Corrected total cell fluorescenece"
  ) +

  theme_bw()

gfp_plot
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "../figures/gfp.png",
  plot = gfp_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

gfp model
```{r}
gfp_model <- lm(
  log_ctcf ~ concentration_g_l * dpf,
  data = log_gfp_reduced
)

summary(gfp_model)
anova(gfp_model)
```


pair-wise post hoc
```{r}
emm_gfp <- emmeans(gfp_model, ~ concentration_g_l | dpf)

pairs(emm_gfp, adjust = "tukey")
```
